name: San José
tagline: Pura Vida Living in Central America's Most Stable Democracy
description: San José is the gateway to Costa Rica's legendary Pura Vida lifestyle — a sprawling capital surrounded by volcanoes, cloud forests, and some of the planet's richest biodiversity. While not a beach town itself, San José offers excellent healthcare, a stable democratic government, established expat infrastructure, and the popular Pensionado retirement visa. The Central Valley's eternal spring climate and proximity to both Pacific and Caribbean coasts make it a practical, comfortable base for FIRE retirees seeking tropical living with First World services.

quickFacts.visa: Pensionado visa for retirees with $1,000+/month guaranteed income. Rentista visa for those with $2,500+/month. Permanent residency after 3 years.
quickFacts.timezone: UTC-6 (Central Standard Time, no daylight saving)
quickFacts.language: Spanish (English spoken in expat areas and medical facilities)
quickFacts.safetyRating: Moderate — petty theft common in downtown areas, safer in suburbs like Escazú and Santa Ana; avoid walking alone at night in central San José
quickFacts.nearestAirport: Juan Santamaría International Airport (SJO) — 20 min from city center
quickFacts.climate: Tropical highland with eternal spring weather (18-26°C year-round). Dry season Dec-Apr, rainy season May-Nov with afternoon showers.
quickFacts.currency: Costa Rican Colón (CRC) / US Dollar widely accepted

housing.description: Modest furnished 1BR in a safe, well-connected Central Valley barrio (quieter edge of Sabana, San Pedro, or the affordable side of Santa Ana); not prime Escazú

dining.description: Casados at neighborhood sodas a few times a week; mostly home cooking

healthcare.description: Enrollment in Costa Rica's public CAJA system plus an affordable local private top-up, with access to private hospitals like CIMA and Clinica Biblica; priced for ages 45-55.

transportation.description: Bus network plus occasional taxi/Uber; no car

entertainment.description: Parks, beach/cloud-forest day-trips by bus, low-key social life

1M.lifestyle: A modest furnished apartment in a safe, well-connected Central Valley barrio — the quieter edges of Sabana, San Pedro, or the affordable side of Santa Ana — walkable to a feria and a bus stop. Most meals come from the kitchen, built on cheap farmers'-market produce, with casados at neighborhood sodas a few times a week for eating out. Getting around is the bus network plus the occasional taxi or rideshare; no car needed. CAJA enrollment paired with an affordable local private plan covers routine care, with Clínica Bíblica and CIMA on hand for anything bigger. Frugal and careful, but genuinely comfortable in a country built for easygoing pura-vida living.

housing.description: Furnished 1BR in desirable Escazú, Santa Ana, or around Sabana, often in a small condominio with pool, gym, 24/7 security

dining.description: Out 3–4x/week mixing soda casados with Escazú mid-range international tables

healthcare.description: Comprehensive local private plan layered on CAJA; fast CIMA/Bíblica access

transportation.description: Buses plus regular rideshare; optional modest car

2M.lifestyle: A furnished apartment in desirable Escazú, Santa Ana, or around Sabana Park — often in a small condominio with a pool, gym, and round-the-clock security — puts malls, cafés, and international restaurants within reach. Eating out three or four nights a week blends soda casados with Escazú's mid-range international tables, and a comprehensive local private plan opens fast access to CIMA and Clínica Bíblica. Around town it's habitual rideshare and buses, with an optional modest car. A fuller calendar of gym sessions, cinema, and weekend trips to the Pacific beaches or the cloud forest rounds out an easy, unpretentious life.

housing.description: Quality furnished apartment/condo in prime Escazú or Santa Ana — gated, amenity-rich, hillside/valley views

healthcare.description: Top-tier comprehensive local private approaching an entry international plan; full CIMA/Bíblica access

3M.lifestyle: A quality furnished apartment or condo in prime Escazú or Santa Ana — gated, amenity-rich, with hillside or valley views — anchors a confident FIRE routine. Dining out is near-daily across Escazú's international scene, groceries lean on Automercado and specialty imports alongside the ferias, and premium local private cover keeps out-of-pocket exposure low with full CIMA and Clínica Bíblica access. A car handles the Central Valley and weekend escapes to Manuel Antonio, Monteverde, or the Nicoya coast, backed by rideshare in town. A rich calendar of dining, wellness, and travel comes with real margin to spare.

housing.description: Luxury condo/townhouse in a top-tier Escazú or Santa Ana gated community (pool, gym, concierge, 24/7 security)

dining.description: Near-daily including Escazú's best tables plus occasional destination fine dining

healthcare.description: Entry international plan (Cigna Global / Allianz tier) with regional coverage

transportation.description: Owned car plus premium rideshare (car-dependent metro; no rail)

domesticHelp.description: Housekeeper 2–3 days/week (Costa Rica 2026 domestic min wage + CCSS)

5M.lifestyle: A luxury condo or townhouse in a top-tier Escazú or Santa Ana gated community — pool, gym, concierge, round-the-clock security — sets the tone, kept tidy by household help a few days a week. Dining spans casual to Escazú's best tables without a second thought, an entry-level international plan (Cigna Global or Allianz tier) adds regional coverage layered over the private hospitals, and an owned car plus premium rideshare covers everything. Discretionary spend flows into wellness, club memberships, and frequent travel across Costa Rica and beyond. Comfortably clear of what daily life here requires, with the surplus going to leisure and savings.

housing.description: Hillside estate in the Escazú/Santa Ana heights — gated grounds, pool, sweeping Central Valley views; top of the long-term luxury stock

dining.description: Near-daily fine dining across the metro's best kitchens

healthcare.description: International concierge cover with cross-border medical evacuation to a US hospital

transportation.description: Luxury vehicle plus on-call private driving (car-dependent, two coasts)

entertainment.description: Lavish entertaining, private events, memberships, frequent travel

domesticHelp.description: Full-time live-out staff (housekeeper-cook plus gardener/caretaker), all-in with CCSS + aguinaldo

luxuryExtras.description: Frequent international travel, exclusive memberships, luxury goods

10M.lifestyle: A hillside estate in the Escazú or Santa Ana heights — gated grounds, pool, sweeping Central Valley views, top of the long-term luxury stock — kept by full-time live-out staff including a housekeeper-cook and a gardener-caretaker. Fine dining is near-daily across the metro's best international kitchens, and international concierge cover with cross-border medical evacuation to a US hospital removes the last friction. A luxury vehicle with on-call driving, gourmet and imported provisioning, and an open-ended budget for constant travel, club memberships, and the finer things mean nothing is out of reach. This is the Central Valley at its most opulent — a trophy address, resident staff, and a country of beaches, volcanoes, and cloud forest as the backyard.
